<a id="summary"></a>

## Summary

No roadmap step; these keep CI trustworthy and close notes the verdict seats left. AC1 to AC3 are independent and start now. AC4 needs #131 merged, AC5 needs #129 merged and AC6 needs #132 merged; do them in that order as each lands. Every build is niced (nice -n 19 taskpolicy -b just shared-build). Tests that time real child processes may run nice-only (prime, 06 Nov).

<a id="goals"></a>

## Goals

- Follow-ups from the 06 Nov roadmap push: fix the CI flakes (F27), make real-child timing tests honest under background QoS (F28), put the skill check in the gate (F26), and land three non-blocking verdict notes from #129, #131 and #132.

| ac-0001 | F27, flakes. Each of these is fixed at its root cause (or, if the cause is outside pij, made deterministic with a named reason): claude_heal_scripts copilot_status_line_hands_the_payload_to_pij_rs_in_one_process (BrokenPipe writing a child's stdin: treat EPIPE after the child has read its payload as success); pane_observer real_tmux; pij-cli claude_inbound daemon_boot_repairs_once_and_publishes_one_change_event (an isolated daemon child exits non-zero); the TS watchdog smoke's private-daemon teardown (exit null); the reaper tests under load. | [ ] unchecked | — | — | [bp-0001](assets/backpressure.dd.md#rows) | — |
| ac-0002 | F28, timing under QoS. Tests that measure real child processes against a wall-clock budget read one test-only scale (for example PIJ_TEST_TIME_SCALE, default 1) so a slow, niced machine stretches the budget instead of failing, and production budgets are untouched. The nice-only rule for such tests is written in AGENTS.md and the shared-build doc. | [ ] unchecked | — | — | [bp-0002](assets/backpressure.dd.md#rows) | — |

Nothing is withdrawn; the record is honest. | [ ] unchecked | — | — | [bp-0006](assets/backpressure.dd.md#rows) | — |

AC6 adds one awaited future per bound-ended turn; no timer, poll or launch. | [ ] unchecked | — | — | [bp-0007](assets/backpressure.dd.md#rows) | — |

<a id="execution-guardrails"></a>

## Execution Guardrails

- Tests use scratch repos and a private daemon; never the live governance branch or the prod daemon.
- Builds: your own target or `just shared-build`; CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0; -p scoping; stop under 25 GB free.
- No `git add -A`, no `--no-verify`; no node_modules, never symlinked (C25); TS proof is CI on the exact head.
- Shared seams (crates/cli wiring, skills/pij): rebase onto main before the PR and keep edits minimal; don't fork the seam.
- One push per review round; no pushes after the PR is out for verdicts unless a verdict asks.
